prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create an original high-end DESIGN EXPLORATION BOARD for an iPhone musician app named "clean tuner". THREE completely different design concepts side by side, three portrait full-height app UI canvases, no phone hardware, no perspective, no existing design references. User has rejected repetitive framed champagne panels, semicircle gauges, guitar headstocks, and mere palette swaps; radically redesign layout, hierarchy, interaction visualization. Contemporary independent industrial design studio taste, sophisticated, exceptionally considered typography and negative space, restrained and warm, useful as a tuner at first glance. Each concept a distinct composition, not the same UI recolored. Flat native app canvases with subtle material where relevant, not physical boxes or cards. Consistent example across all: GUITAR, STANDARD, fifth string A2, measured -8 cents (flat). Accurate six string tuning E2 A2 D3 G3 B3 E4, highlight only A2. No giant start/listening button. No smileys, no charts with meaningless decoration, no huge settings dashboard, no fake screws. Sharp high-resolution text. Landscape presentation board on quiet neutral background, three tall screens separated by generous space. Small external editorial headings "01 / TRACK", "02 / TYPE", "03 / OPTIC". No marketing copy.

CONCEPT 01 TRACK — modern precision audio field instrument, horizontal pitch track.
Edge-to-edge very light warm grey #E8E9E3 app background, matte texture extremely subtle. Small "clean tuner" top left, one minimal settings icon top right. Large beautifully typeset "A₂" upper-left with small "-8 ct" aligned upper-right and tiny "LOW". Main interaction across middle upper screen: continuous HORIZONTAL ribbon of three note zones G♯ / A / A♯, no enclosing card, no semicircle. Current A region defined by softly contrasting rectangular tint, with a fine signal-red moving marker very slightly left of its center, soft localized white illumination; neighboring regions partially fade at edges. It looks like a precise analog radio frequency track translated to a contemporary app, NOT retro vintage radio. Three labels above their zone, light sparse boundary marks only between zones, no dense ticks. Below some carefully proportioned open space. Lower third has very small elegant whole-guitar outline beside "Guitar" and "Standard ▾"; then a SINGLE horizontal set of six shallow circular string targets labeled E₂ A₂ D₃ G₃ B₃ E₄, with A₂ red filled circle, others fine charcoal type on background. Micro string numbers 6 5 4 3 2 1 underneath. Bottom tiny "MIC ON" with dot and "440 Hz". Avoid excessive framing, orange champagne palette or headstock. Composition distinctly asymmetrical and organized, simple physical tactility only in string targets.

CONCEPT 02 TYPE — warm editorial minimalism, soft bone and muted deep plum, expressive readable typography.
Edge-to-edge warm bone paper-white #F2EFE8 with deep aubergine ink #3C2837. Tiny clean tuner at upper left. HERO NOTE A₂ large with elegant modern condensed sans serif, slightly left of center, roughly upper half; not absurdly oversized. Beneath a small row "-8 cents" and "slightly low". Main pitch feedback is a SHORT VERTICAL plum glowing capsule placed to right of hero note: three stacked note areas, A♯ above, A center, G♯ below. Current light point slightly BELOW center of A area meaning flat. Discreet upright labels alongside three areas, no tick ruler, no needle, no semicircle. Lower half: a tiny FLAT geometric full guitar silhouette centered, no photoreal texture; below it a beautifully aligned TWO ROW, THREE COLUMN grid of note choices with no button outlines, E₂ A₂ D₃ / G₃ B₃ E₄. Selected A₂ has a small plum dot beneath and bolder type. Header above this lower group "Guitar / Standard ▾". Bottom minimalist reference 440 Hz and tiny microphone-status dot. Warm, contemplative, tactile-looking through typography and spacing. No bevelled panel, no skeuomorphic guitar tuning pegs. Delightful and distinct, not generic finance dashboard.

CONCEPT 03 OPTIC — dark compact laboratory optical display, premium contemporary music gear.
Edge-to-edge warm very dark charcoal #202321. Single thin top header clean tuner and tiny "GUITAR / STANDARD ▾". Hero visualization in upper-middle: luminous HORIZONTAL soft white line with three broad optical zones indicated by labels G♯ A A♯ above it. Center A zone brighter; single narrow lime-white light slit slightly left of center represents -8 cents. Thin frosted translucent strip surrounding line, no grid of ticks, no waveforms. The light feels like it passes through real smoked glass, carefully controlled, NOT gaming neon and NOT a massive glow blob. A₂ in crisp ivory large but moderate type beneath the optical line, with "-8 ct" offset small to right. Tiny "RAISE PITCH" below. Lower third: abstract but recognizable guitar BODY outline in very faint grey, with SIX small ivory dot targets arranged in a straight row ACROSS the body's soundhole area, labeled E₂ A₂ D₃ G₃ B₃ E₄ ABOVE row. Selected A₂ target warm acid yellow #D9EF7B and connected to a fine luminous string line down to bridge; other targets neutral. Keep diagram small and distilled, NOT a realistic guitar. Bottom status "LISTENING" tiny, "A4 440" aligned right. Quiet optical depth, dramatic negative space, modern technical legibility.

Every screen must be beautiful on its own, intentional hierarchy, actual restrained music utility, not a moodboard of textures. Distinct silhouettes of UI layouts, do not repeat same module positions. No existing hardware product logos.
status: Three independent concept directions; no implementation changes
review: Concept only. Pitch marker displacement schematic rather than calibrated. Optic guitar drawing faint and needs contrast review if selected.
